# ChartElement

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Compatibility wrapper that assigns data to a chart before rendering it.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `ElementBase`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new ChartElement(chart: ChartBase, data: ChartData, altText?: string)
new ChartElement(chart: ChartBase, data: ChartData, options: ChartElementOptions)
```

## Properties

- [`altText`](#alttext): Alternate text used when the document is generated as PDF/UA-1.
- [`isDecorative`](#isdecorative): Marks the chart as decorative even when altText is set.

### `altText`

```typescript
altText: string
```

Alternate text used when the document is generated as PDF/UA-1. A chart with alt text is tagged as a Figure; without alt text it is treated as decorative artifact content.

### `isDecorative`

```typescript
isDecorative: boolean
```

Marks the chart as decorative even when altText is set.
